draft.narration:
The cane comes down and finishes the rat clean — but the blow is still traveling when the bank beside you tears open, and something far bigger surges out of the nest, jaws wide, with the dog that's been shadowing you since the crossing already snarling in at your side to meet it.

You drive the cane in and catch the huge thing already lunging, and it recoils with a shriek.

The dog darts in at its flank and comes up short, jaws snapping on air.

The Rat Mother convulses and another rat comes boiling up out of the torn earth beside her, and she goes still, spent by the effort.

The new rat darts for the dog and skitters off without finding purchase.

You swing at the rat and your cane cuts nothing but fog.

The dog snaps down on the rat and flings it sideways with a yelp of its own.

The Rat Mother stays frozen where she reared up, not stirring.

The rat gets its teeth into the dog's shoulder and the dog snarls and shakes it off too late.

You strike at the rat and miss your footing on the churned grass.

The dog bears down on the rat again and it goes half-limp under the bite.

The Rat Mother still hasn't moved.

The rat lunges for the dog and only grazes fur.

You swing again and the rat is too quick, too low.

The dog snaps and comes up empty.

The Rat Mother finally surges forward at the dog and overreaches.

The rat darts in at the dog and misses clean.

You bring the cane down and the rat stops moving under it.

The dog's jaws close over the rat a heartbeat later, already still.

The Rat Mother lunges for the dog and the dog is already gone from where she struck.

Your cane cracks across empty air where the Rat Mother's head was a moment ago.

The dog gets in low and tears a strip from her flank, and she screams.

The Rat Mother wheels on the dog and misses it entirely.

You get the cane in under her guard for a solid hit.

The dog lunges and she twists clear of it.

She comes down on the dog and doesn't connect.

You catch her a glancing blow that still tells.

The dog gets its teeth in again, deep.

She swings for the dog and misses.

You swing for her and she's already moving.

The dog catches her a solid strike.

She rears back from the dog, unmarked by the attempt.

You put everything into the swing and it lands hard, staggering her.

The dog goes for her and comes away with nothing.

She turns on the dog and drives into it, and it yelps hard, staggered.

You swing and she twists away from it.

The dog bites down on her again, solid.

She catches the dog square, and it goes down hard.

Your cane lands another blow on her.

The dog is gone before she can retaliate, and she doesn't find it.

You strike again and she takes it without flinching.

The dog is not there to hit anymore, and she doesn't stir toward it.

You catch her again, glancing but real.

The dog, already fallen, is where she throws her weight anyway, teeth finding nothing.

She rounds on you now that the dog is down, and you catch her blow with the cane instead of your arm.

You swing and she's not where you aimed.

You strike and miss.

She lunges for you and comes up short.

You swing again and she slips past it.

She lunges again and doesn't connect.

You aim for her and she isn't there.

She finally catches you, teeth raking your side.

You get the cane in on her despite the wound.

She comes for you again and misses.

You swing and she twists clear.

She misses you again.

Your swing goes wide once more.

She catches you across the ribs.

You swing and she slips it.

She catches you again, harder this time.

You get a solid hit in through the pain.

She answers with teeth in your shoulder.

You land another blow on her.

She tears into you again.

You swing and miss entirely.

She misses you in turn.

You catch her a clean hit.

She doesn't manage to answer it.

You strike again, and it tells on her.

She gets her teeth into you hard.

You swing and she's already past the cane.

She, too, misses you clean.

You swing wide again.

She bites down on you again, deep.

You land one more solid strike.

She answers in kind, teeth finding you again.

Your footing gives on the churned, bloody mud, and the swing goes nowhere.

She catches you square while you're still recovering your feet.

You wrench free of the fight and run, leaving her behind in the fog.

fight.name: the Rat Mother

note: A dog has been trotting at her heel since the crossing — it is hers now, or near enough. The nest in the roadside bank opens and the Rat Mother comes out of it, huge and hostile, and she will not flee. Declare the fight: the dog fights alongside her with 12 health, 1–3 damage, dc 12, bonus 2. The Rat Mother has 20 health, 2–4 damage, dc 12, bonus 2, and an ability that spawns a Rat (5 health, 1–2 damage, dc 10, bonus 1) and then leaves her not stirring for 2 rounds. athletics, dc 12 to hit her, their_dc 11, flee_dc 10.

proposal.summary: You drive the cane down for a finishing blow on the rat.

outcomes.text: the blow lands clean and the rat drops dead — and the bank beside it tears open, something far larger clawing out of a hidden nest, while the dog that's followed you since the crossing plants itself snarling at your side
the cane catches it hard enough to finish it, and before its body's even still the nest in the bank splits open behind it, huge and hostile, the dog already between you and it
the rat dies under the blow but the dog shoulders in ahead of you to meet what's coming out of the nest, throwing off your footing as the huge thing rears up

your cane is still finishing the rat when the nest erupts mid-swing, so the same motion that kills it carries straight into meeting the enormous thing lunging out behind, the dog snapping in beside you

the rat dies and in the instant the nest tears open the fog itself goes utterly still over that one patch of bank, as if something were holding its breath, before the huge shape and the dog both come forward into it

the rat drops and what climbs out of the nest looks back at you with eyes like two flat coins that catch no light at all, wrong in a way you have no word for, while the dog stands its ground against it anyway

chosen.text: your cane is still finishing the rat when the nest erupts mid-swing, so the same motion that kills it carries straight into meeting the enormous thing lunging out behind, the dog snapping in beside you
